integrity: Analytic first-step proof and independent standard-library exact-rational finite checks are supplied. Numerical enumeration is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Strictly positive four-parameter binary second-order chains; independent target from one-time stationary law; first positive hitting time. Does not classify degenerate tensors, larger alphabets or longer memories. Historical priority remains subject to external checking.
title: Kemeny rigidity and exact memory defects in positive binary second-order chains
